hook: Lady Juliana stands trial in a grand courtroom, facing severe accusations of witchcraft and calmly admitting to healing the sick.
cliffhanger: Juliana proudly declares she admits to healing the sick, leaving the court poised for a severe backlash.
standalone_clarity: A viewer can easily understand that a woman is on trial for practicing medicine/witchcraft, though her exact backstory requires context.
narrative_context: The opening of Juliana's trial where she faces the Judge and refuses to cower.
promotional_strength: Showcases the protagonist's striking resilience and calm defiance against a hostile legal system.

evidence.observation: The Judge formally accuses Lady Juliana of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.
Juliana proudly and with dignity states she admits to healing the sick.

logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.

source_segments.label: JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]

source_segments.label: JUDGE (O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: Do you deny possessing this book?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: No.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

source_segments.label: JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: Do you deny using its remedies?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Firm)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: No.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

source_segments.label: JUDGE (Hard, Pressing)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I admit to healing the sick.

hook: Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the dock in passionate fury as false witnesses pile up against her.
cliffhanger: Juliana stands tall in the courtroom light, proclaiming that herbs are medicine, not magic, leaving her fate hanging on her refusal to yield.
standalone_clarity: Clearly presents a framed protagonist fighting back against false accusations in a kangaroo court.
narrative_context: The height of the trial where multiple townsfolk give coached testimony and Juliana fiercely defends her herbal practices.
promotional_strength: High emotional stakes, strong dramatic conflict, and an inspiring display of a character refusing to let truth be branded as evil.

evidence.observation: Juliana passionately protests the false characterization of her actions.
Juliana firmly asserts that herbs are medicine, not magic.

logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Indignant)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: It was not a ritual!

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

source_segments.label: JUDGE (Bellowing)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: You will speak when addressed!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

source_segments.label: LORD (Calm, Poisonous)
source_segments.speaker: LORD
source_segments.text: We have further witnesses.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

source_segments.label: TOWNSMAN (Nervous, Fearful)
source_segments.speaker: TOWNSMAN
source_segments.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

source_segments.label: JUDGE (Sharp)
source_segments.speaker: JUDGE
source_segments.text: And?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

source_segments.label: TOWNSMAN (Agitated)
source_segments.speaker: TOWNSMAN
source_segments.text: She became violently ill.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

source_segments.label: OLD WOMAN (Shrill, Accusatory)
source_segments.speaker: OLD WOMAN
source_segments.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

source_segments.label: LORD (Mocking, Smug)
source_segments.speaker: LORD
source_segments.text: She calls it healing.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

source_segments.label: LORD (Resonant, Vindicative)
source_segments.speaker: LORD
source_segments.text: The people call it poisoning!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Incisive, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: What were their illnesses?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

source_segments.label: LORD (Dismissive)
source_segments.speaker: LORD
source_segments.text: Irrelevant.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Fierce)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: It is not irrelevant!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Clear, Unyielding)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!
